project.name: ECHO//ZERO
project.description: Sci-fi/fantasy mystery game. A grieving AI reconstructs reality from memories. 20-30 min vertical slice target.
project.design_thesis: The smallest possible system that proves the largest possible idea. One verb (RECALL). One environment (The Aerie). One emotional truth.

tools.ai_plan: Google AI Pro (Gemini, AI Studio, Colab)
VERIFY_CURRENT_CAPABILITY: Exact Cinemachine version for Unity 6.3 LTS
UI Toolkit data-binding API surface in Unity 6.3
Antigravity AGENTS.md vs GEMINI.md precedence in current Antigravity 2.0 release

architecture.pattern: Layered architecture with strict one-way dependency flow
architecture.scene_loading: Additive only — never single-mode after bootstrap
architecture.config_format: ScriptableObjects for static data, JSON for runtime config

principles: One verb, many uses — RECALL is the single mechanical thread
Grief, not conspiracy — the emotional engine is loss, not mystery-box villainy
Restraint is the flex — the vertical slice proves the idea, not the universe
Build for the laptop — every decision is constrained by RTX 4060 / 16 GB RAM
Plan before code — no agent skips PLAN step
Test before commit — no code lands without a corresponding test
ADR before override — no silent architectural changes

phases.name: Discovery
phases.deliverable: Design thesis, pillars, vertical slice concept

phases.name: Architecture
phases.deliverable: ARCHITECTURE.md, 10 ADRs, layer model, system contracts

phases.name: Foundation
phases.deliverable: AGENTS.md, DECISIONS.md, TASKS.md, antigravity.project.json, repo structure

phases.name: Build — Core Gameplay
phases.deliverable: Unity project, EventBus, ServiceLocator, Bootstrap, Player, RECALL, Fragment pickup

phases.name: Vertical Slice
phases.deliverable: Full Aerie playable: Mira, Drift, Choice, Reveal

phases.name: AI
phases.deliverable: Level 1-2 AI — improved Drift, Mira adaptation

phases.name: ML Experiments
phases.deliverable: First learned component — only if P6 baseline measured

phases.name: Red Team
phases.deliverable: Security audit, save corruption tests, safety review

phases.name: Portfolio
phases.deliverable: README, architecture article, demo script, resume bullets

may_not: Design new systems without an ADR
Add ML dependencies without ML_ENGINEER sign-off
Change architecture to hit a budget without a new ADR

quality_gates.name: Idea Validation
quality_gates.evidence: Design thesis, kill-critic review, Phase 1 complete

rules: Every class with business logic gets an EditMode test class
PlayMode tests for Unity lifecycle dependencies
No test may depend on scene state without explicit setup/teardown
Tests must be deterministic — no random seeds without fixed seed in test

requirements_before_enabling_agents: Sandboxed from save file write access

evaluation.experiment_registry: Each experiment gets: experiment_id, hypothesis, env_version, agent_version, config, seed, metrics, results, artifacts, conclusion

performance.target_device: RTX 4060 Laptop / 16 GB RAM / 8 GB VRAM

git.branch_strategy: feature branches for tasks, main for verified integrations
